question: X7: the CLAUDE.md Overleaf rule ('run pull --dry-run, report, and ask') conflicts with A5/A6; change its wording?

solvers.answer: F7: under A5 and A6 the rule would make every collaborator edit a question; the later decisions take precedence in substance, but only the author can amend CLAUDE.md.

refutation.note: Confirmed: A5 and A6 (28-29 Oct) are later than the 22 Oct rule. Precondition: X5a fixed, or a pull still cannot be followed by a push.

precedence_note: A5/A6 (28-29 Oct) supersede the 22 Oct CLAUDE.md rule in substance; the wording is the author's to change.
final_answer: Replace the rule with: 'If push refuses (Overleaf edits not pulled back): pull, apply the edits under the A5 rules (applied as text and recorded; any edit that breaks a lock is held as a visible note), push, and list them in the digest; ask only about T3 items.' Effective after the X5 fix. Until the author agrees, the current rule stands.
answer_short: Your CLAUDE.md Overleaf rule is replaced so that coauthor edits are pulled and applied under A5, with questions only for T3 items.
question_for_author: May the Overleaf rule in your CLAUDE.md become: 'If push refuses (Overleaf edits not pulled back): pull, apply the edits under the A5 rules (applied as text and recorded; any edit that breaks a lock is held as a visible note), push, and list them in the digest; ask only about T3 items'? ('OK CLAUDE.md' from the earlier digest also works.)
alternatives: Keep the current rule: every coauthor edit that blocks a push becomes a question to you

actions.detail: Replace the push-refusal rule with the proposed wording, after the X5 fix.

consequences: Coauthors' Overleaf edits would be pulled and applied without asking you; you would see them as digest lines, and only held lock conflicts or T3 items would come to you. Takes effect after the X5 sync fix.
recommendation: Yes, effective once the X5 sync fix is in.
default: Nothing changes: the current rule (run pull --dry-run, report, and ask) stands.
